discussion_comments.comment_body: No, we shouldn't implement anything in the base class. When destroying a session we need to both destroy the cookie and its underlying store value. Otherwise, a user could "log out" (destroy their browser cookie) but an attacker could reuse the browser cookie and still access their session (since the underlying store data exists).
